summary: Healthcare remains the AI industry's biggest vertical, with health AI investments ballooning to $3.7 billion — more than double the past year, according to a new Menlo Partners report. Provider organizations are looking to deploy AI in new areas, with the most popular ones being front-office operations and clinical copilots, the report shows. Even though established health IT companies continue to dominate the ambient scribing space, providers are increasingly turning to startups for AI-driven clinical and administrative tools.
